findings.title: Bearer token is not yet valid
findings.explanation: The JWT's `nbf` claim is 2h 0m in the future. The server will reject it until then. Likely a clock-skew issue between the token issuer and the local machine.
findings.suggested_fix: Check the system clocks on the issuer and the client. If skew is small, wait it out; otherwise sync NTP.

findings.title: Weak TLS protocol negotiated (TLSv1.1)
findings.explanation: The connection negotiated TLSv1.1. Anything below TLS 1.2 is considered insecure and is rejected by modern clients (browsers, Python 3.12+, recent OpenSSL builds).
findings.suggested_fix: Disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1 on the server. With nginx: `ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;`.
